sources.name: nflverse-data (open NFL data release)
sources.what: Weekly player box scores, injury reports, depth charts, rosters, snap counts, schedules and scores; built from the NFL GSIS feed and NFL Next Gen Stats.
sources.caveat: A redistribution, not the NFL itself. Every game row is cross-checked against NFL.com / ESPN in this repo.

sources.name: ESPN public scoreboard & summary JSON
sources.license: ESPN terms of service; factual data only, not redistributed raw
sources.what: Scores, final-state flags, starting lineups and inactives for cross-checks and lineup status.
sources.caveat: Undocumented public endpoint; treated as a secondary check, never as sole authority for a published number.

sources.name: NFL.com official schedule and game pages
sources.what: Official schedule, kickoff times and game-page links used for per-row provenance.
sources.caveat: HTML can change without notice; matches are recorded as file snapshots with a timestamp.

sources.name: Pro-Football-Reference
sources.what: Playoff seedings, closing lines for older seasons, pressure and coverage context tables.
sources.caveat: HTML tables; blocked to the authoring sandbox, fetched from CI only where reachable.
